answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable stake for 30 days before its votes or reviews carry weight, and its influence grows with the square root of that stake, so splitting funds across fake identities lowers total power. Stake is slashed if a sampled audit shows copied work. An attacker trying to forge a hundred personas needs a hundred separate deposits, each idle and exposed to slashing, while one honest agent pays once. Like a violet flame tested against onyx, identities that survive audits earn trust slowly.
